Description.DefaultText: Your body's internal temperature. When high, you risk dehydration and heat stroke, when low, you risk frostbite or hypothermia, and have a higher chance to catch a cold.
Description.Text: 你身体的内部温度。过高时，有脱水和中暑的风险；过低时，有冻伤和体温过低的风险，并且会更容易得感冒。
Description.zh: 你身体的内部温度。过高时，有脱水和中暑的风险；过低时，有冻伤和体温过低的风险，并且会更容易得感冒。
Description.en: Your body's internal temperature. When high, you risk dehydration and heat stroke, when low, you risk frostbite or hypothermia, and have a higher chance to catch a cold.
Description.ja: 体内の温度。高いと脱水になりやすく、低いと凍傷と低体温症になる可能性があり、風邪もひきやすい。

GameName.ja: 体温が上がりすぎて死んだ。

Description.DefaultText: You died of a heat stroke.
Description.en: You died of a heat stroke.

Description.DefaultText: I'm going to die if I don't cool down...
Description.Text: 再不冷却我就要热死了……

Description.en: I'm going to die if I don't cool down...
Description.ja: はやく体を冷やさないと危ない・・・
